visual_direction.name: Clinical Precision Meets Human Warmth (Humanist Healthcare Minimal)
visual_direction.rationale: TheraBridge bridges high-stakes pediatric clinical therapy with compassionate, parent-facing care. The visual system pairs structured, high-density data grids for clinicians/administrators with a tactile, warm, reassuring interface for guardians. It rejects flat, sterile AI templates in favor of crisp borders, layered micro-elevations, multi-tone signature accents, and responsive layout adaptations tailored to role-specific emotional contexts.

alternative_typeface_proposal.name: Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit for Hero & Section Headings
alternative_typeface_proposal.reasoning: While IBM Plex Sans offers technical authority and optimal tabular legibility for clinical metrics, pairing it with Plus Jakarta Sans for top-level headers introduces warm, friendly geometric curves that soften the clinical environment for parents and pediatric therapists.

type_scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
type_scale.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug
type_scale.caption: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide text-slate-500 uppercase

logo_rules.light_surface: Display raw transparent PNG (infinity/puzzle icon + 'TheraBridge' wordmark) directly on light backgrounds (#FFFFFF, #F6F7F9, #FAF8F5).
logo_rules.dark_surface: CRITICAL: Raster logo washes out on dark surfaces. ALWAYS wrap logo inside a crisp rounded chip (e.g. `bg-white/95 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-slate-200/50`).

layout_and_shell.signature_band_usage: 3px horizontal strip (`h-[3px] w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#052464] via-[#0F5692] via-[#0DA8B8] to-[#7A4AB7]`) applied at the top edge of headers, cards, or hero banners.

breakpoints_and_responsive.320px_390px: Mobile Portrait: Hidden sidebar. Top bar with brand logo chip, role switcher pill, and notifications. Fixed bottom nav bar with 4 primary action icons + 'More' menu button. Data tables collapse into stacked cards. Horizontal day chips stack vertically.
breakpoints_and_responsive.768px: Tablet: Collapsed left sidebar (icon-only, 64px wide). Drawer menu for sub-navigation. 2-column bento grids for cards and charts.
breakpoints_and_responsive.1024px_1440px: Desktop: Collapsible full desktop sidebar (~254px width). Dynamic breadcrumb header. Selected nav item displays tinted background (`#E8F0F8` for clinicians/admins, `#E3F3F5` for family), 3-4px left indicator bar, and role-colored icon (`#0F5692` for clinicians, `#0A7385` for family).

component_inventory.cards: Subtle 1px border (`border-[#E4EAF3]`), rounded-xl (`rounded-xl`), smooth hover transition (`hover:border-[#AABDD1] hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200`).

component_inventory.disabled_states: Unbuilt or restricted clinical actions (e.g., signing notes, releasing records without approval) display a lock icon, muted opacity, and a hover tooltip explaining the regulatory or system reason.

screen_1_platform_admin.title: Platform Admin Dashboard
screen_1_platform_admin.purpose: System-wide monitoring of centers, trial health, pending applications, and operational audit log with zero access to protected clinical data.
components: Header with system health indicator & quick filter
KPI Metric Grid: Total Active Centers, Pending Applications, Active 30-Day Trials, Critical Alerts
Pending Center Applications Queue with quick approve/review modal triggers
Trial Centers Usage Monitor (Days remaining, child count, therapist limit meters)
Platform Event & Audit Timeline with severity filter pills

screen_2_center_admin.title: Center Administrator Dashboard
screen_2_center_admin.purpose: Operational management of pediatric therapy center, staff onboarding, trial quota enforcement, and session schedules.
components: Trial Quota Consumption Meter Card (1 Child, 3 Therapists, 30-Day Limit)
Operational Snapshot Metrics (Sessions Completed Today, Staff Invitations Pending, Compliance Score)
Onboarding & Setup Checklist Widget with interactive completion steps
Staff & Therapist Invitation Table with specialty tags and status badges
Upcoming Session Feed for the Center

screen_3_therapist_daily.title: Therapist Daily Workspace
screen_3_therapist_daily.purpose: High-efficiency agenda for clinicians to manage daily appointments across multiple specialties.
components: Dynamic Context Line: 'Monday, 19 October · Speech & OT Therapy Workspace'
Specialty Switcher Pill Toggle: 'Speech Therapy', 'Occupational Therapy', or 'All Specialties'
Interactive Day Calendar & Time-Slot Agenda
Appointment Cards with specialty tags, child avatar, goal focus, and session status
Clinical Task & Action Items Side Panel

screen_4_child_profile.title: Child Profile & Clinical Workspace
screen_4_child_profile.purpose: Comprehensive 360-degree pediatric workspace with strict permission gates.
components: Child Context Header: Name, Age, Primary Diagnosis, Care Team Avatars, Guardian Quick-Link
Sticky Context Tab Bar: Overview, Providers, Goals, Sessions, Progress, Reports, Plans, Evidence, Guardians, Access
Active Goals & Progress Milestones Tracker
Recent Clinical Session Notes & Evidence Gallery
Guardian Access & Consent Management Card
Disabled Note Signing & Records Release Controls with inline regulatory explanation tooltip

screen_5_parent_home.title: Parent Home (Dual Light & Dark Theme Support)
screen_5_parent_home.purpose: Reassuring, mobile-first guardian experience tailored for daily therapy tracking and therapist communication.

themes.light_theme: Warm & Inviting (#FAF8F5 background, #0A7385 teal highlights, soft sand tiles)
themes.dark_theme: Cozy Night Mode (#0D1226 canvas, #151B33 surface, #5CCFDB family accents)

components: Warm Personal Greeting & Selected Child Switcher Pill
Next Scheduled Appointment Spotlight Card with location & therapist details
This Week's Plan: Desktop horizontal spacious day chips / Mobile stacked activity cards
Released Progress & Daily Home Practice CTA
Therapist Messaging & Request Status Feed

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and status indicators MUST include explicit `data-testid` attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. `data-testid="specialty-switcher-speech"`).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Interactive elements require minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.state_coverage: Every screen must handle 6 essential UI states: Loading, Empty, Error, Success, Disabled (with hover reason), and Confirmation Modal.
